history_note: Frozen before any GCOV change map, flag count or optical comparison of the new observable was computed. Before freezing, only product metadata and the global value ranges of one granule (16 August 2026, HH and HV) were inspected, to choose the primary channel and the noise margin below. The same dates were examined in the v2 coherence study: they are development data, not an independent holdout.

site.scope: OCP Benguerir phosphate mine only; Guemassa is excluded

extension.batch: P05036, collection NISAR_L2_GCOV_V1; separate analysis, never pooled with the main period

homogeneous_batch: same collection, CRID, track, frame, orbit direction, polarisation and span; ascending and descending are never differenced with each other

primary.quantity: gamma-0 linear power (terrain-normalised backscatter), NISAR L2 GCOV frequency A
primary.aggregation: 2 x 2 native samples averaged in linear power before the dB conversion; zone aggregates also in linear power
primary.why_primary: HH is well above the noise-equivalent backscatter over the whole scene; HV median power is within about 3 dB of it in the inspected granule

secondary.role: reported with its own quality layer; cells within the noise margin are excluded and counted, not interpreted as no change

auxiliary.role: context only: persistent low coherence relative to a control (v2 observable); never renamed surface change

observable.effective_resolution: the 10 m grid is not the effective resolution: numberOfLooks and the adaptive multilooking of the product apply; the empirical spread in the control is the working precision

quality.noise_margin_note: cell power below 2 x noise-equivalent backscatter (3 dB) is excluded; the product states that noise correction is not applied
quality.water_and_built_land_cover: context only; never used as an automatic rejection
quality.unknown_property: a quality property the product does not state stays unknown; no shadow or layover mask is invented

baseline.rule: the temporal reference of a pair is the per-cell median change of homogeneous pairs of the same span sharing no acquisition with it; fewer than the minimum gives insufficient_baseline

flagging.rule: cell flagged when |residual - control centre| > k * robust sigma of the calibration control residuals
flagging.control: ring 1-4 km outside the perimeter, built-up and industrial exclusions removed (as v2); calibration / evaluation halves are alternating 1 km blocks
flagging.interval_scope: conditional on this protocol: not on the choice of control, geometry, threshold or interpretation

optical_comparison.dependency_rule: comparisons sharing the same two optical scenes are one temporal support; counts are reported per distinct optical pair

references.purpose: evaluate detection of visible surface change at the working resolution, not the cross-sensor agreement
references.unit: 20 m analysis cell blocks (60 m x 60 m = 3 x 3 cells) so that the unit exceeds the effective resolution of both sensors
references.reserved_for_evaluation: units are drawn once, from a seed recorded in the sampling file, before any annotation; Z1 and the most spectacular zones are not privileged
references.automated_or_agent_proposals: labelled as such; never counted as independent human review
references.no_target_accuracy: no accuracy target is chosen after seeing results; a confidence interval level is not an accuracy

claims_not_made: excavation demonstrated by radar variation alone
mining boundary or concession (the perimeter is a historical map)
